items.name: scene-cell
items.prompt: A full-frame hand-drawn 2D cartoon scene illustration for a comedic stickman prison-escape adventure game, in the spirit of classic Henry Stickmin style art. The scene is the interior of a dim prison cell at night. The composition places a simple white stickman protagonist with a round head and thin limbs, drawn in pale #eef2f6, sitting thoughtfully on a low metal cot at the left-center of the frame, his silhouette instantly readable against the dark background. On the right side stands a tall barred cell door and a small barred window, through which cool blue moonlight slants in and casts long bar-shaped shadows across the floor. A tiny warm amber #fbbf24 key lies on the floor near the bars, glowing faintly as the obvious interactive hook. The walls are flat blue-gray stone in #1a2230 and #2a3440 with a few cracks and a faded poster shape, and the floor is a darker #101418. Lighting is low-key and moody, dominated by cool blue moonlight with a single warm amber accent on the key, creating a sneaky nighttime mood. Materials read as flat cel-shaded stone, dull metal bars, and a thin mattress, all rendered with bold clean black outlines and a few soft gradients. The camera is a straight-on wide side view framed as a 16:9 game scene, with the lower portion kept relatively clear for the choice-button UI. The art style is a refined hand-painted 2D cartoon with exaggerated comedic proportions, clean bold outlines, flat cel shading, and a cohesive dark blue-gray night palette accented by amber #fbbf24. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
